knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to find the cause in the job records before changing the service, so the change addresses the real problem. Adding a new service (option 0) and ignoring the complaints (option 2) are both named errors.

The lesson requires the scope, hazards, licence requirement and price to be checked before an add-on is offered. Customer demand alone (option 0) and a competitor offering it (option 2) do not confirm the team can deliver it safely.
The measure section says to record the measure before and after the change, and review it after a fixed period.

practicalCriteria: Learner reviews a supplied set of job records and identifies a repeated failure with a cause, not a guess.
Learner writes an add-on service definition with scope, hazards, licence requirement, time and price, and marks it not offered where the team does not hold the licence.
Learner records the measure to be improved before a change and sets a review date.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Improvement log with measure, change, review date and outcome
Add-on service definition with scope, hazards, licence and price
stopWorkCriteria: Learner offers a licensed or restricted service the business does not hold the licence for
Learner offers an add-on whose hazards have not been assessed
